studies.limitation: No people were recruited and no statement is a participant quote. These are research-derived hypotheses that can prioritize outreach, not evidence of demand or demographic endorsement.
studies.next_step: Stop simulated ideation. Report compensated outreach, real payments, repeat use, false-positive and false-negative results, and attributable customer quotes.

outcomes.label: Paid experiments
outcomes.summary: LotMatch, WeedCheck, and DoorHold retained a business payer, narrow trigger, bounded phone action, and explicit falsification gate.

outcomes.label: Compensated co-design only
outcomes.summary: CaptionGap remained a mission-led accessibility hypothesis and cannot advance from simulated reactions.

outcomes.label: Repeated failure patterns
outcomes.summary: Coordination, safety, compliance, gig-finance, application, and medical-bill concepts repeated known platform, trust, incumbent, and two-party adoption failures.

studies.sample_label: Five demographic signal clusters plus specialist reviews

segments.label: Single parents
segments.objection: Fragmented school and custody systems, adversarial safety, and required second-party adoption make a general coordinator brittle.
segments.primary_job: Recover time and make school, household, and co-parent handoffs predictable from one person's phone.
segments.signal: One-person utility and fewer coordination steps were more attractive than another shared network.

segments.label: Seniors and caregivers
segments.objection: A phone event can create false reassurance, while surveillance framed as care damages trust.
segments.primary_job: Reach a trusted human, resist scams, and preserve dignity without continuous monitoring.
segments.signal: Human escalation and explicit control were stronger than passive safety automation.

segments.label: Adult entertainers
segments.objection: Defamation, retaliation, sensitive identity storage, cold start, and venue power make a network dangerous.
segments.primary_job: Protect privacy, income continuity, and physical safety without creating a retaliatory data trail.
segments.signal: Worker control and sponsor-funded safety research were more credible than a shared blacklist.

segments.label: Ages 18–24
segments.objection: Low subscription tolerance, incumbent platforms, and financial or legal risk weaken generic copilots.
segments.primary_job: Manage volatile cash flow, work scope, applications, and early-career administration.
segments.signal: Immediate relief mattered, but broad AI organizers did not feel worth another subscription.

segments.label: Ages 25–30
segments.objection: Cross-system state, infrequent use, and feature-level value keep broad household assistants weak.
segments.primary_job: Coordinate small-business work, childcare, benefits, and increasing responsibility for parents.
segments.signal: A business payer at an operational decision point was more credible than a consumer organizer.

studies.summary: A cross-market persona exercise tested whether urgent problems from parents, caregivers, accessibility users, adult entertainers, gig workers, and younger adults created a credible paid mobile product.
studies.title: XPRIZE market and persona synthesis

studies.limitation: The panel predicts reactions from secondary research. It contains no recruited participants, observed behavior, willingness-to-pay evidence, or real quotations.
studies.next_step: Recruit 12 real participants. Require at least seven to create a Loop, six to send it, 40% recipient follow-through, 60% closure with an outcome, and three independent second-use requests.

outcomes.label: Advanced to real-user validation
outcomes.summary: The panel narrowed Loop toward adults who already have relationships but struggle with fragmented communication and follow-through. Its current canonical decision is still shown separately.

segments.label: Teen social user, 16
segments.objection: Will not recruit a whole group or pay, and Snapchat already owns communication.
segments.primary_job: Feel connected and creative without drama or exclusion.
segments.signal: Moderate interest around tests, trips, sports, and group plans if the interaction feels playful.

segments.label: College organizer, 21
segments.objection: Formal events invite a direct Partiful comparison and cannot be the hero use case.
segments.primary_job: Coordinate people without creating another chaotic chat.
segments.signal: Strong interest if guests can follow and update without installing.

segments.label: Time-poor professional, 29
segments.objection: Friendship must not feel like task management.
segments.primary_job: Stay close to dispersed friends and remember important outcomes.
segments.signal: Strongest broad-consumer fit because one update can reach everyone who cares.

segments.label: Notification-overwhelmed user, 31
segments.objection: Read receipts, streaks, overdue badges, and guilt mechanics are disqualifying.
segments.primary_job: Communicate care without accumulating reply debt.
segments.signal: High interest when states such as no response needed reduce pressure.

segments.label: Privacy-conscious parent, 38
segments.objection: Requires precise audience control, encryption, and no contact-book harvesting.
segments.primary_job: Update family without public child photographs or several parallel chats.
segments.signal: High interest for travel, school, health, and family logistics.

segments.label: Creator or photographer, 35
segments.objection: The product does not create discovery or income directly.
segments.primary_job: Update supporters and collaborators without serving an algorithm.
segments.signal: Moderate interest for finite projects, shoots, launches, and delivery milestones.

segments.label: Adult rebuilding a social circle, 26
segments.objection: A relationship tool cannot manufacture local network density.
segments.primary_job: Meet people and convert weak ties into real friendship.
segments.signal: Low initial utility before relationships already exist.

segments.label: Digital minimalist, 44
segments.objection: Will reject an app that recreates a feed or sends frequent pushes.
segments.primary_job: Keep essential connection while spending less time in feeds.
segments.signal: Strong interest in finite updates delivered by digest or web.

studies.summary: A synthetic panel attacked the finite social-object concept from eight relationship, coordination, privacy, and attention contexts before real recruitment.
studies.title: Loop social-product synthetic panel
